summary: When a coworker voices fear, the organizer agrees it is real, answers briefly and truthfully, and turns back to the plan.
realLife: The union guide teaches affirm, answer, redirect for objections like fear of retaliation: validate the worry, give a short truthful answer, and return to the issue.
sources: UAW, How to Have an Organizing Conversation (union training guide): https://uaw.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/How-to-Have-an-Organzing-Conversation-FINAL.pdf
inGame: a coworker tie and the worker's cautious or fearful trait pick the reply; needs: unions as organizations

turns.summary: The organizer tells the coworker they are wrong to be afraid.
turns.writesBack: the coworker closes off; a tie drop

turns.summary: The organizer agrees it is risky and lets the matter go.
turns.writesBack: no ask; the issue stays open

turns.summary: The coworker quietly agrees days later.
turns.writesBack: a small tie bond; a promise
